title: Image Widget
subtitle: Display images from various sources such as assets, network, files, or memory.

properties.name: image
properties.description: The image provider that supplies the actual image pixels (AssetImage, NetworkImage, etc.).

properties.name: fit
properties.description: How the image should fill its container bounds (cover, contain, fill, etc.).

properties.name: width & height
properties.description: Sets the explicit layout bounds of the image container.

properties.name: repeat
properties.description: Determines how the image tiles to fill empty spaces when bounds exceed source dimensions.
